AI can write faster than 100% of humans—but does that mean it can write well? In this segment, Keshava Guha compares the rise of AI in writing to Deep Blue's victory in Chess, warning that we risk losing our cognitive ability to solve problems. Meanwhile, Andaleeb Wajid explains why she is "proprietary" about her characters and why a bot can never understand the lived, niche experience of a "Labbay" Indian Muslim girl.
Thank you for watching our video!
